steps: Identify improvement target for obesity & metabolic syndrome using statistical process control baseline
Design PDSA intervention cycle with specific change idea and measurement plan
Execute rapid-cycle testing with weekly data collection and team review
Spread successful changes with adoption toolkit and implementation support
Sustain improvements with control charts and standard work documentation
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — clinical pathway adherence. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Target 85% adherence. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Compare against guideline targets. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Trending toward 95%. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit.
treatments.escalation: If no improvement after 90 days, escalate to specialist for root cause analysis. If adverse effects, pause and review within 14 days.
